title: Meal plan
subtitle: Menus that fit your calories and protein, built from food that is already around you.

entry.title: Meal plan
entry.body: A day and a week of menus that fit your calories and protein.
entry.bodyPro: Today's menu is ready. Open it to see or swap meals.

loadError: Could not load the plan. Try again in a moment.
noProfile: Finish your profile first so your calorie and protein targets can be worked out.

empty.title: No plan yet
empty.body: We build a 7-day menu from your calorie and protein targets, favouring food you already eat. You can swap any meal.

regen.title: Rebuild the menu?
regen.bodyWeek: Meals you have not eaten are replaced with a new set. Anything you logged stays.
regen.bodyDay: Today's meals you have not eaten are replaced with a new set. Anything you logged stays.

day.sourceBase: Base target. If you work out, the target goes up and that day can be rebuilt
day.noMeals: No meals left to plan today.

item.ateFailed: Could not log it. Try again.
item.avoid: Has something you avoid. Try a swap.

swap.title: Swap meal
swap.subtitle: Options with similar calories and protein.
swap.none: No good swap for this meal yet.
swap.replanned: The other meals of the day were adjusted so the total still fits.

recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.source: Nutrition is computed per ingredient from the tables above, not estimated by AI.
recipe.aiNote: The recipe text was written with AI help. The nutrition numbers were not.
recipe.habitNote: This is food you logged yourself. The numbers are the average of your own logs, not from a recipe.
recipe.sourceUsda: USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy), for ingredients TKPI does not have

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.subtitle: From this week's meals you have not eaten yet.

prefs.title: Plan settings
prefs.allergiesHint: Meals with these never show up.
prefs.dislikesHint: Type an ingredient or dish to avoid, like mushroom or fish.
prefs.cookHint: Each meal is marked cook or buy. Mixed uses both.
prefs.saved: Saved. Rebuild the plan to use these settings.

locked.title: Meal plan is for Pro
locked.body: Daily and weekly menus that fit your calories and protein, a shopping list, and recipes with TKPI nutrition.

why.budget: Total {{kcal}} kcal, {{pct}}% off the {{budget}} kcal target.
why.protein: Protein {{planned}} g against a {{target}} g target.
why.proteinShort: Protein {{planned}} g, short of the {{target}} g target. Add a protein side if you are still hungry.
why.history: {{n}} meals come from food you already eat often ({{names}}).
why.better: {{name}} is picked as a lighter version of {{from}}, saving about {{kcal}} kcal.
why.portion: {{carb}} is cut to {{amount}} so calories and protein fit.
why.variety: The same meal is not repeated more than twice in a week.
why.live: Today's target already includes the calories from your workout.
why.base: The days ahead use your base target. If you work out, the target rises and that day can be rebuilt.

errors.noPlan: No plan yet. Build one first.
errors.notFound: Meal not found in the plan.
errors.futureEat: A meal on a day that has not come yet cannot be logged as eaten.
errors.badAlternative: That swap does not fit this slot.
